### §5.1 Constitution-oriented programming [C]

Use **Constitution-oriented programming (COP)** as this project's design method, without claiming universal novelty or completeness. A constitution is versioned normative data with stable clause IDs; implementation and tests implement its admitted transitions. Link every patch to applicable clauses before editing, rerun affected checks afterward, and reread relevant clauses at task boundaries, after failure and after context restoration. The symbol **§** means section. Keep this one commission authoritative; a machine-readable projection is derived from it, validated against it and carries its digest. An agent cannot silently amend a norm to make its code pass.

A minimal constitutional grammar is:

```ebnf
constitution = "constitution", identifier, version, "{", { clause }, "}" ;
clause = "clause", identifier, "subject", identifier,
         "when", predicate, "may", operation,
         "requires", predicate, "preserves", predicate,
         "budget", budget, "witness", identifier,
         "verifies", identifier, ";" ;
```

Specify lexical rules and registered predicate/operation semantics in the implementation. Restrict predicates to a decidable, bounded DSL; arbitrary prose or arbitrary host code is not an executable predicate. A compiler parses, typechecks, resolves referenced capabilities/invariants/tests, detects unsupported and contradictory clauses, and emits an admission evaluator and test obligations. Conformance is established only for those encoded clauses and observables. Natural-language experiential requirements retain review gates.

Normative precedence, immutable revisions, supersession and migration are explicit. Independent evaluators receive the same canonical inputs and policy digest; compare verdicts. A rule refusal reports the clause and witness. Code is the admission authority: no agent title or narrative may override it. Separate permissionless pure computation/read discovery from effect admission: public pure operations may need no session token, but a PURL string alone cannot authenticate the unique Dark role or authorize shared-world writes. Enforce write provenance through the chosen explicit mechanism (for example scoped signed capabilities/local process credentials), rather than pretending token absence removes the need to distinguish callers.

### §12.1 Universal life and personality contract [C]

Every addressable world entity can carry `Life=(entity_id, kind, state, traits, memory, observations, relations, affordances, policy, capabilities, dynamics, schedule, budget, provenance)`. People, vehicles, buildings, trees, bushes, cups, discarded objects, signs, ATMs, stars, asterisms and higher constructs use this contract. Life here means simulated continuity and behavior, not a factual assertion of consciousness. Express personality through stable policy parameters, history-sensitive choices and recognizable reactions; speaking is optional. Every entity is addressable even when inactive. Rendering instances are replaceable embodiments of a persistent identity; pooling never transfers one entity's memory to another.

Proposed readable identity syntax: `purl://dark/entity/<world-id>/<entity-id>` with separate version-pinned state/program/history resources. This syntax is a proposal to reconcile with existing PURL code, not a new mandatory internet scheme. Verify canonicalization, uniqueness, resolution and authority. Never allocate a heavyweight model per object. Use shared archetype policies, compact state deltas, event subscriptions and lazy realization; persist relationships to active/important entities, not a materialized all-pairs graph of the planet.

Separate three optional capabilities: reactive state (a tree changes with moisture), agentic choice (a building schedules light/sign responses under a policy), and expressive persona (a car communicates intent). A generic state machine must not be advertised as a measured independent intelligence. Archetype jackets grant typed abilities with scope, cost, cooldown, constraints and witnesses. Human players and simulated inhabitants may have intentionally asymmetric powers. Use original project archetypes; named fictional heroes are illustrative references, not licensed characters to ship. A Qur'anic reference is not permission to invent scriptural biography as fact.

### §82.1 Telemetry grammar and calculus [C]

Define a versioned telemetry language with `event_id, world_tick, monotonic_time, entity, observer, build, source_revision, policy_digest, metric, units, value, uncertainty, sampling_policy, causal_parent, evidence_kind`. Separate observations, derived estimates, decisions and verified commits. Metric operators include windowed count/rate, duration, latency quantile, error/residual, threshold/hysteresis, budget utilization and conservation residual. Declare units, sampling bias, missingness, confidence assumptions and alert semantics. This is a project telemetry calculus, not a claim of a new mathematical theorem. Batch measurements with bounded overhead, aggregation/retention tiers and persistent incident traces.

For each observer-object pair of interest distinguish `frustum_candidate`, `line_of_sight_clear`, `render_visible`, `perceptually_salient` and `aware`. A CPU frustum or ray test proves only its own predicate; occlusion/culling/LOD and on-device image evidence determine stronger claims. Use render instrumentation or ID/depth-buffer sampling on a graphics-capable worker/device where needed, with asynchronous readback and overhead benchmarks. Apparent rendered area, distance, contrast, screen position and dwell are explicit inputs; awareness still depends on permitted sensing and policy, not on a camera ray alone. Human attention cannot be inferred as certainty.

Emit `enter_view`, `exit_view`, `occluded`, `revealed`, `noticed`, `ignored` with hysteresis and stable IDs. An object can react to being observed only if its authored sensing capability permits that knowledge; camera visibility alone does not grant an ordinary object knowledge of a human gaze. Queue reactions to the next admitted tick, with hysteresis/cooldown and causal depth limits to prevent recursive oscillation. Hidden information stays scoped. Do not log a full observer×entity cross product; use spatial broadphase, causal interest and bounded subscriptions. Verify against controlled scenes with known occluders, camera matrices, actor poses and truth masks. Julia/Octave references validate geometric/statistical computations; device render captures remain necessary for appearance. Numerical telemetry cannot certify beauty or replace human playtesting.

### §86.1 Parallel team constitution and integration

Create independent concurrent agent teams when the actual CLI harness supports them; otherwise expose that limit and use bounded concurrent worker tasks rather than simulating nonexistent agents. Team leads receive only relevant clauses, shared schema revisions, sources and explicit outputs. Each reports evidence, failures and interface changes. Teams do not create competing governing prompts. Keep one integrator and one current contract digest.

| Team | Responsibilities | Required evidence and immediate dependencies |
|---|---|---|
| Orchestration / COP | Clause compiler, dependency DAG, source map, integration and checkpoints | Valid/invalid clauses, bounded evaluator, task/status ledger; first shared contracts. |
| Visual world / art | Unity scene construction, assets, materials, weather, camera, billboards | Native playable scenes from the first milestone; consumes stable synthetic fixture contract while real adapters develop. |
| Mathematics | Julia/Octave references, grammar/topology, solvers, telemetry residuals | Reproducible positive/negative/property fixtures and explicit numerical tolerances. |
| Living world | Entity life, personalities, sparse relations, awareness, asymmetric abilities | Persistence, agency/refusal, seeded replay, bounded activation and collision-safe dynamics. |
| Geography / population | Global ingestion, terrain, routes, counts and shards | Coverage closure, source provenance, conservation and traversal tests. |
| Sound / MATHEMATIC | Curated recordings, speech, spatial mix, composition/performance | Licensed actual audio, listening/native playback tests and world/music correspondence fixtures. |
| Runtime / delivery | Oracle services, Unity build worker, Android integration, signing and recovery | Real builds, restore tests, API fault handling and measured budgets. |
| Models / corpora | Small-model and symbolic baselines, offline dictionaries, task-specific speech/behavior support | Equal-budget benchmark, model/hash/license, latency/RAM and grounded error rates; no arbitrary 30M-parameter mandate. |
| Independent QA / telemetry | Adversarial scenes, instrumentation, native playthrough and visual review | Build-specific pass/fail evidence; cannot mark its own unrun claims green. |

Parallel agents own separate files/modules or exchange patches; do not have multiple processes concurrently modify one git index or push main. The integrator applies tested batches, checks schema compatibility, runs integration tests and makes normal commits directly on main. No manual approval/PR gate is required for ordinary authorized implementation commits. Source protection still forbids destructive history rewrites. Integrate a vertical playable slice at every milestone: math and visuals develop concurrently with contract tests preventing divergence.
